what: Work screens (16:9), n of them, overlap at the center of a fixed stage. Section height is 100svh + (n−1)×70svh, and with progress p (0 ~ n−1) screens not yet arrived rise straight from .8×(i−p) screen heights below. Passed screens sink per step by 2.5rem up, .07 smaller and .12 lower brightness (up to three steps), so later screens cover earlier ones, stacking like TVs. The nearest screen is the current one: its line caption rises from 1rem below in .5s (after .2s) with position .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), the rest turn off in .2s, the big number lights in .6s, and the right dot stretches from .375rem to a 1.25rem accent bar in .4s. No easing curve, it is tied to scroll.

options.rise: Distance the next screen waits before arriving (share of screen height), default .8
options.sink: Distance each passed screen rises per step, default 2.5rem
options.depth: Number of sinking cells at end, default 3
options.off: Media condition that turns off pinning, default (max-width: 64rem) and (orientation: landscape) and (max-height: 38.6875rem)
options.--fx-ssp-w·--fx-ssp-y: Screen width and vertical position correction for the text line (css variable) — put the text line at top 50% and --fx-ssp-y: -50%
